stem: A harvest label detaches before the container is received. What is the strongest response?
choices: Hold the affected material and resolve identity through the controlled process before normal movement continues
Receive it under the most common cultivar
rationale: Hold the affected material and resolve identity through the controlled process before normal movement continues. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
